d:
West Bengal voters Anita Jaswal and Iftikhar Ahmed alleged that their names were deleted from electoral rolls during the SIR process despite having voter IDs and other documents. Speaking at an INDIA bloc protest, they questioned the deletion of their names and demanded answers from the Election Commission, saying the exercise has left them worried about their citizenship and voting rights.
